title: Public Procurement (Preference to Make in India) Order 2017
authority: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT), Ministry of Commerce & Industry
summary: Mandates purchase preference and eligibility thresholds for Class-I and Class-II local suppliers in public procurement by all Central Government Ministries, Departments, Autonomous Bodies, and CPSEs.

clauses.rulebook_title: Public Procurement (Preference to Make in India) Order 2017
clauses.title: Class-I Local Supplier Minimum Content Threshold
clauses.legal_text: 'Class-I local supplier' means a supplier or service provider whose goods, services or works offered for procurement meets the minimum local content of 50%. Only Class-I local suppliers are eligible for purchase preference in CPCL tenders.

conditions.failure_message: Violation of MII Order Para 3(a): Declared local content is below 50.0% Class-I threshold.

clauses.rulebook_title: Public Procurement (Preference to Make in India) Order 2017
clauses.title: Chartered Accountant UDIN Certification Mandate
clauses.legal_text: For tenders exceeding ₹10 Crore in estimated value, the local content declaration shall be certified by the statutory auditor or a practicing Chartered Accountant possessing a valid Unique Document Identification Number (UDIN) issued by ICAI.

conditions.failure_message: Violation of MII Order Para 9(b): Chartered Accountant UDIN certificate is unverified or missing for high-value procurement package.

clauses.rulebook_title: Public Procurement (Preference to Make in India) Order 2017
clauses.title: Penalties for False Declarations of Local Content
clauses.legal_text: False declarations of local content percentage or location of value addition will be in breach of the Code of Integrity under Rule 175(1)(i)(h) of GFR 2017, for which a bidder or its successors can be debarred for up to two years.

conditions.failure_message: Statutory Action under MII Order Para 9(f): Adverse finding of false local content declaration.
